lead.headline: Canada sets dollar-for-dollar tariffs on U.S. goods for Sept. 8
lead.dek: Carney says Washington 'asked too much and offered too little' after 50% U.S. duties took effect
body: Prime Minister Mark Carney said Saturday that Canada will put retaliatory tariffs on American steel, dairy, appliances, farm equipment, paper and electronics on Sept. 8, after 50% U.S. tariffs on about $20 billion in Canadian goods took effect at midnight.

Canada will match the duties dollar for dollar, Carney said in Ottawa: 'We take this step reluctantly.' U.S. Trade Representative Jamieson Greer said Canada declined to finalize a deal reached earlier in the week and that no new talks are planned.
Carney said late changes to the U.S. terms 'called into question the reliability of any deal'; Trump posted that Canada 'wants the benefits of being a State, without being one.'

briefs.headline: Judge voids the 75-country immigrant visa ban
briefs.summary: A federal judge ruled Friday the ban violates immigration law's bar on nationality discrimination and set aside denials made under it.

briefs.headline: Interior orders Colorado River cuts through 2028
briefs.summary: Arizona loses 760,000 acre-feet, California 440,000 and Nevada 50,000 under the two-year plan, with Lake Mead and Lake Powell at record lows.

briefs.headline: Texas court cuts Alex Jones judgment to $1.5M
briefs.summary: The appeals court found the Sandy Hook parents did not show harassment past a $750,000 damages cap; a $1.4B Connecticut judgment stands.

briefs.headline: TikTok to pay $400M over children's privacy
briefs.summary: The settlement ends a 2024 Justice Department and FTC suit over data collected from users under 13 without parental consent.

briefs.headline: Wrong-way driver kills seven, two of them police, in England
briefs.summary: A pursued car hit a police vehicle head-on near Middlesbrough early Saturday, killing all seven people in the two vehicles, two constables among them.

briefs.headline: Iran calls joining U.S. sanctions an act of enmity
briefs.summary: Security official Mohsen Rezai said countries joining new U.S. sanctions are 'considered an enemy'; the Treasury promised a coordinated squeeze.

briefs.headline: Kazakhstan votes for a single-chamber parliament
briefs.summary: Seven approved parties, all aligned with President Tokayev, contest the new 145-seat legislature; the same overhaul reset his term limits.

briefs.headline: Magnitude 5.9 quake injures at least 37 near Tokyo
briefs.summary: The overnight quake under southern Ibaraki disrupted trains and damaged a building; the prime minister urged vigilance for a similar shock.

briefs.headline: Two young people die in Clay County crash
briefs.summary: A car and a state vehicle collided on Route 16 near Indore Saturday afternoon; a third young person was hospitalized.

briefs.headline: WVDOT studies the interstate split where four died
briefs.summary: The department is weighing anti-skid surfacing, rumble strips and warning lights at the I-64/77 split after a fourth barrier crash since 2022.

regional.item: An unidentified body was recovered from the Kanawha River near Patrick Street on Saturday afternoon.

away.item: Police say the charter down on Foothills Boulevard had lost power in one engine; the TSB has the case.

fishing.line: 242 cfs and falling - pushy. Wadeable at the edges, not across.
Sound highs 4:55 a.m. and 5:40 p.m.; lows 11:12 a.m. and 12:07 a.m. Monday.

briefs.headline: Spin explains stars that survive black holes twice
briefs.summary: Rapidly spinning stars shed less material each pass, so their repeating flares fade - seen in four of about 10 known systems.

briefs.headline: Webb finds early galaxies hiding faint stars
briefs.summary: Spectra of nine early galaxies show far more faint stars than assumed, making them three to four times heavier. Nature Astronomy.

briefs.headline: Greenland shark eyes show no aging at 400 years
briefs.summary: Sharks caught off Greenland showed no age-related retinal cell death; one examined eye was about 200 years old. Nature Communications.

briefs.headline: High-dose vitamin D tied to better cognition scores
briefs.summary: Among 54 older adults with mild impairment, daily 5,000 IU users scored 13% higher on cognition tests; the small study shows association, not cause.

art.caption: A reach stacker swings a container at a Montreal freight yard, where the new tariffs land first.

weather_ear: Jim Claudtore has the morning's forecast at 7:15.
kicker: The away desk returns from Prince George; Huntington, Parkersburg, Nicholas and Summers were quiet.
